label: final-evidence-consistency
argv:
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,time,collections
out=Path("/Users/rex/Documents/ChatGPT/mobile-native-skill/validation/feedback-forward/neutral-review/pass4");b=Path("/Users/rex/Documents/ChatGPT/mobile-native-skill")
load=lambda p:json.loads(p.read_text())
initial=load(out/'input-shas.json')['files'];checks=[]
for key,v in initial.items():
 p=Path(v['path']);checks.append({'key':key,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'original_sha256':v['sha256'],'unchanged':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==v['sha256']})
(out/'final-input-integrity.json').write_text(json.dumps({'checkedAtUnix':time.time(),'all_unchanged':all(x['unchanged'] for x in checks),'files':checks},indent=2)+'\n')
assert all(x['unchanged'] for x in checks)
assert load(out/'reviewed-checks.json')['counts']=={'passed':23,'failed':1,'unassessed':42}
assert load(out/'admit-targeted.json')['status']=='not_accepted'
assert load(out/'admit-full.json')['status']=='not_accepted'
assert load(out/'admit-reviewed-library.json')['status']=='not_accepted'
assert len(load(out/'evidence-ledger.json')['rows'])==66
assert len(load(out/'evidence-ledger.json')['na_cells'])==10
rows=[]
for p in sorted((out/'commands').glob('*.json')):
 x=load(p);rows.append({'label':x['label'],'exit_code':x['exit_code'],'startedAtUnix':x['startedAtUnix'],'endedAtUnix':x['endedAtUnix'],'elapsedSeconds':x['elapsedSeconds'],'record':str(p.relative_to(out))})
md='Every runner entry retains full actual subprocess argv, stdout, stderr, start/end Unix timestamps and child exit code. The Python runner process itself returns 0 after recording child failures; consult the child exit_code. Negative-control expected rejections are recorded in integrity-controls.json. Initial reconstructed readouts and transport limits are separately labeled.\n\n| Actual command label | Child exit | Elapsed seconds | Record |\n| --- | ---: | ---: | --- |\n'
for r in sorted(rows,key=lambda x:x['startedAtUnix']):
 md+='| '+r['label']+' | '+str(r['exit_code'])+' | '+str(round(r['elapsedSeconds'],6))+' | '+r['record']+' |\n'
(out/'COMMANDS.md').write_text(md)
(out/'commands-index.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'review_started':load(out/'START.json'),'currentUnix':time.time(),'original_input_files_verified_unchanged':len(checks),'logged_subprocesses_before_this_final_check':len(rows),'actual_nonzero_subprocesses':[{'label':r['label'],'exit_code':r['exit_code']} for r in rows if r['exit_code']],'output_file_count_before_seal':len([p for p in out.rglob('*') if p.is_file()])},indent=2))
